products.title: Floor & Furniture Repair Kit - Mix & Match Any Color

description.plain:
Repair damage on wood floors and furniture instead of replacing the whole surface. The Coconix Floor & Furniture Repair Kit pairs kneadable epoxy wood putty with 10 mixable repair compounds to rebuild deeper damage and blend the visible finish. The Mix & Match color set supports both common wood tones and more unusual colored finishes.

What can this Mix & Match repair kit repair?

  • Scratches, chips, gouges and worn edges
  • Deeper cracks, holes and missing corners after the surface is stable
  • Color and grain around a completed repair

Use on compatible hardwood, laminate, veneer, cabinets, doors, trim and wood furniture. Test the finish in an inconspicuous spot. Fix active moisture, loose flooring or structural movement before a cosmetic surface repair.

What is included?

  • One kneadable epoxy wood putty stick
  • 10 repair compounds: black, mahogany, walnut, cherry, oak, maple, white, yellow, blue and red
  • Reusable mixing jar
  • Scraper and gray spatula for preparing, spreading and leveling
  • Blue applicator brush for grain and small details

How do I repair a scratch, chip or hole?

  1. Prepare and clean. Remove loose material and dust, clean the area and let it dry. Test any cleaner on a hidden spot first.
  2. Rebuild missing material. For damage wider or deeper than 1/4 inch (6 mm), knead the wood putty and press it into the void. Smooth and let it harden as directed in the manual. A shallow scratch may only need repair compound.
  3. Mix a test color. Choose the closest base tone, add a second color gradually in the jar and compare a dried test with the surrounding finish.
  4. Apply thin layers. Work the matched compound into the damaged area, allow each layer to dry and level it with the spatula.
  5. Restore grain and finish. Use the brush to imitate nearby wood grain and color variation, then blend the edges after the repair is dry.

When should I use the wood putty?

Use it where a chip, gouge, hole or corner has lost material and needs a base beneath the color compound. Surface scratches and light wear may not require putty. A moving board or ongoing water damage must be corrected before refinishing the visible area.

How do I match the wood tone?

Blend small amounts of the supplied colors and test on the surface after drying; wet compound can look different. Use the brush for fine grain lines rather than covering an entire board with one flat color. For help with a difficult finish, send Coconix Support a natural-light photo and follow the full manual.

description.plain:
Restore Your Wood Floors & Furniture to a Like-New Finish

Give your wooden surfaces a fresh lease of life with this easy-to-use Wood Scratch Repair Spray. Whether it's a scuffed hardwood floor, a worn tabletop, or a scratched shelf, this quick-dry formula hides minor defects, restores natural wood luster, and leaves behind a smooth, protective gloss — no tools, no sanding, no mess.

Each pack includes 2 x 60ml bottles, giving you plenty of product for multiple touch-ups around the home. Made in Mainland China.

Key Benefits

  • Instant Visual Renewal: Fills and conceals minor scratches, scuffs, and surface wear on wood floors and furniture for a clean, polished appearance.
  • No-Tools Required: Simply spray evenly onto the affected area and allow to air-dry naturally — no sanding, buffing, or specialist equipment needed.
  • Long-Lasting Gloss: Forms a thin protective coating that helps preserve the wood's shine and extends the lifespan of your furniture and flooring.
  • Wide Compatibility: Suitable for hardwood floors, laminate, tables, shelves, cabinets, and most finished wood surfaces in homes, offices, or rental properties.
  • Family-Friendly DIY: Safe and straightforward — ideal for homeowners, renters, and anyone who wants professional-looking results without professional costs.

Product Specifications

Product Name Wood Scratch Repair Spray
Volume 60ml per bottle
Pack Size 2 bottles
Dimensions Approx. 3.4 × 12 cm (1.34 × 4.72 in) per bottle
Suitable Surfaces Wooden furniture, hardwood & laminate flooring, tables, shelves
Application Spray-on, air-dry
Origin Made in Mainland China

How to Use

  1. Clean the surface area to remove dust and debris.
  2. Shake the bottle gently before use.
  3. Hold the spray 20–30 cm from the surface and apply an even coat over the scratched or worn area.
  4. Allow to air-dry naturally. Apply a second coat if desired for deeper coverage.
